# imPRESSive Juice Bar

> Cold-pressed juice bar at 719 High St, Portsmouth, VA 23704, inside Bloom Market. Cold-pressed juices, wellness shots, detox packages, food and gift cards. Orders are for in-store pickup only; the shop does not deliver. Phone (757) 381-6980. Email info@impressivejb.com.

## Visit and order

- Address: imPRESSive Juice Bar, inside Bloom Market, 719 High St, Portsmouth, VA 23704
- Hours: Tuesday to Friday 7am-7pm, Saturday 8am-5pm, closed Sunday and Monday
- Ordering: order online at https://www.impressivejb.com/products and pick up at 719 High St. Pickup only, no delivery.
- Phone: (757) 381-6980
- Email: info@impressivejb.com
